subject: SOC2 Type II request + fallback attestation plan for Options Health procurement
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@optionshealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 Type II + bridge attestation for procurement deadline

Hi Markus / Ben,

Apologies for the last-minute ping. Procurement at Options Health needs the final SOC 2 Type II report (covering period Jan 1 2026 - Dec 31 2026) to clear our legal review. Our procurement deadline is Friday, Feb 12 EOD PT. If you cannot provide the auditor-issued Type II in time, would Redwood be willing to provide an interim bridge attestation (covering the audit gap through Jan 2027) and a package of evidence for key controls?

Specifically, they asked for:
- auditor report (if available) or bridge/attestation letter
- network diagrams and control owner contacts
- a short answers doc for SIG and CAIQ items flagged during review (I can share a redline)

We can sign the SOW once we have a satisfactory attestation and evidence bundle. If this is not possible by Friday, the deal will move to a longer procurement cycle. Can we get confirmation on what you can deliver by Feb 12 and whether a brief bridge letter is an option?

Attaching the procurement deadline snapshot from our side.

Thanks,
Liam
Options Health — Procurement
attachments: procurement-deadline-snapshot.pdf

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC2 Type II + bridge attestation for procurement deadline

Team — forwarding Options Health ask. They have a hard procurement cut on Feb 12 and will sign once they get either the auditor Type II or a credible interim attestation + evidence bundle. Quick summary and asks:

1) Can Compliance/Security produce an auditor-signed bridge letter in <72 hours? If not, what is the fastest formal attestation we can produce?
2) Which pieces of evidence (network diagrams, change logs, key control owner confirmations, CAIQ/SIG answers) can we package within 48 hours?
3) Legal: any concerns about giving an interim management attestation vs auditor bridge (cc Laura) — need wording we can live with.

This is a +$500k ARR new customer; we need to be pragmatic. If a full auditor bridge takes longer, propose we issue: (A) a short management attestation letter signed by SOC owner, (B) a curated evidence bundle (packaged and timestamped), (C) an explicit remediation/attestation timeline for anything missing. Provide owners and ETA and I'll coordinate with Liam.

Proposed war-room schedule: 10:30 AM PT quick sync today to triage and assign evidence pulls.

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-2026-report.pdf (current public artifact), bridge-letter-draft.docx (initial language we can edit).

-Markus
SVP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded message attached below ---

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC2 Type II + bridge attestation for procurement deadline

Thanks Markus — digging in. Short answers and options: 

- Auditor bridge letter: our auditor (Northpoint) typically requires an approval window and their own review; turnaround for an auditor-signed bridge is 5 business days minimum. Not feasible for Feb 12.

- Management attestation + evidence bundle: feasible in 48-72 hours if we can get control owners to sign off on the evidence we collect. I can produce a concise management attestation letter (signed by me as Head of Security & Compliance) and include: network diagram, firewall rule summary, active change-log extract for Q4 2026 — Q1 2027, PKI/cert statements, and confirmation emails from control owners. This does not replace a Type II but should satisfy procurement as an interim measure.

- SIG/CAIQ answers: we can extract the flagged items and provide short, referenced answers (1-2 sentences each) within 24 hours if Ben can provide the redline and assign owners.

Tasks / owners (proposed):
- Network diagram & firewall summary: Infrastructure (Hiro Tanaka) — 24 hours
- Change-log extract for relevant services: Platform Infra (Ethan Park) — 24 hours
- Control owner confirmations (access reviews, patching cadence): Appsec/CustOps owners — 48 hours
- Legal review of attestation text: Laura — need review by EOD today

Risks / notes:
- Management attestation will be accompanied by a cover note explaining this is an interim measure pending auditor bridge. Procurement teams accept this frequently but we must avoid definitive auditor language.
- We should not commit to any retroactive control coverage beyond what we can prove with logs/timestamps.

I can lead the evidence packaging. If Ben can open the redline and connect owners, we can hit the 48–72 hour window. Happy to hop on the 10:30 war-room.

— Monica
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
attachments: bridge-letter-draft.docx

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@optionshealth.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + bridge attestation for procurement deadline

Liam — thanks for the clarity and deadline. We heard back internally: full auditor bridge will take too long, but we can provide the following deliverables aligned to your procurement ask by Feb 14 EOD PT: 

1) Management attestation letter (signed by Redwood Security) stating control posture and audit period coverage, with explicit wording that this is an interim attestation pending final auditor Type II.
2) Packaged evidence bundle: network diagram, firewall summary, change-log extract, and short SIG/CAIQ Q&A for flagged items.
3) Contact list for control owners and timestamps for the evidence produced.

We will also include a brief remediation timeline for any gaps and an offer for a 30-day good-faith credit if the auditor report is delayed beyond the mutually agreed timeline (happy to discuss credit details during the legal review).

Can we schedule a 20-minute call tomorrow (Feb 12) at 09:00 AM PT to confirm wording? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and share the initial attestation draft beforehand.

Thanks — Ben
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
